exact_semantic_question: What does NODI code C mean for a FY2025 DMR row with no numeric result?
relation_contract: no_numeric_result_case.nodi_code must be interpreted before missing-evidence classification

candidate_interpretations.label: documented_no_discharge_period
candidate_interpretations.statement: Code C documents that no discharge occurred during the monitoring period, analogous to a no-discharge DMR reporting action.
candidate_interpretations.note: All 150 FY2025 C rows are on permit NM0000116 with empty DMR_VALUE_NMBR, but the NM0000116 permit package in workspace does not define NODI C or provide NO DISCHARGE box instructions.

candidate_interpretations.label: form_defined_no_data_indicator
candidate_interpretations.statement: Code C is an EPA DMR No Data Indicator with a fixed form-defined meaning.
candidate_interpretations.note: No NODI or No Data Indicator legend appears in workspace structured sources or permit-package text extracts.

candidate_interpretations.label: monitoring_not_required
candidate_interpretations.statement: Code C marks a period where required monitoring was not applicable or not triggered.
candidate_interpretations.note: All 150 FY2025 rows with NODI_CODE='C' have OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG='N', indicating monitoring is not marked optional in structured limit data.

candidate_interpretations.label: missing_evidence_despite_required_monitoring
candidate_interpretations.statement: Code C is only a reporting placeholder and does not by itself establish any documented no-data state for Purpose C.
candidate_interpretations.note: Workspace sources show the code value but not its semantics; absent establishing text, classification must remain unresolved.

contradictory_evidence.effect: Structured data does not support treating C as marking optional or non-triggered monitoring.

known_limitations: No NODI or No Data Indicator codebook exists in sources/ structured tables.
No workspace document defines the meaning of NODI code C.
EPA dictionaries, NetDMR legends, and training-data definitions are out of scope and were not used.
Structural correlation of C with empty numeric results and permit NM0000116 cannot substitute for an authoritative code definition.
